svg.title: Model routing filter chain
svg.desc: Models route filters candidates by target task, capabilities, capacity headroom, and lowest configured token cost.

g.text: LoadRoutingConfigContext loads .config/models/routing.yaml; hasRoutingTag finds candidate tiers.
hasTaskCapabilities verifies all requested capabilities are declared on candidate models.
quotaEligible checks projected RPM, TPM, and ensures no active 30s 429 cooldown.
betterTaskRoute compares estimated token costs to find the lowest-cost candidate.
qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct wins with lowest configured cost; TaskRoute is returned.
The request requires specific capabilities: tools, json.
hasTaskCapabilities checks each model in the tier against required capabilities.
Candidate missing requested capabilities is excluded from further evaluation.
Candidate matches declared target task and requested capabilities.
projectTaskCapacity projects +1 RPM and request TPM against exhaustion threshold.
quotaEligible returns false; over-limit or cooling candidate is skipped.
Multiple candidates in midweight tier pass task, capability, and quota checks.
betterTaskRoute detects equal estimated cost ($0.00) and evaluates model ID.
Lexicographically smaller model ID wins the deterministic tie-break.
